data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 gross claims outstanding were GBP 53.254m. During 2016 the technical provisions show a small gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 0.256m. The report notes prior-year activity as a minor movement overall, while the year was dominated by current-year catastrophe activity (notably Fort McMurray wildfires, Hurricane Matthew, Texas hail & flooding and Gatlinburg wildfires) which increased claims for the accident year; reinsurance recoveries materially influenced net outcomes.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes adverse prior year development of GBP 1.1m (2015: GBP 4.8m favourable).

Net claims incurred during the year have resulted in an increase in the net combined ratio to 117.0% (2015: 99.1%). The principal driver for the net loss ratio of 77.9% (2015: 58.2%) is a combination of catastrophe and risk loss activity during the current accident year.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserves taken from the prior-year comparative column of the Statement of Financial Position (explicit). Prior-year development taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' line in the Technical Provisions note (gross figure shown as (256) GBP 000 -> interpreted as a GBP 0.256m release). There is apparent inconsistency between the narrative (which refers to 'adverse prior year development of GBP 1.1m' - a net figure) and the Technical Provisions gross movement; table signs/parentheses conventions in the report are ambiguous. lob_movements are derived from the per-line prior-year development table (these appear to be net amounts by line and so confidence is reduced). The claims development triangle exists and is provided; RITC activity in other parts of the report was noted historically but does not appear to distort the 2016 gross triangle materially.
